project.name: Brecon Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 21 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Brecon qualifies as a local detour through Brecon Museum and Royal Welsh Regiment Museum. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Brecon: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Brecon offers Brecon Museum, Royal Welsh Regiment Museum, Ely Tower of Brecon Castle within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Brecon Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Brecon Museum and Royal Welsh Regiment Museum, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
